curated-attraction:stonehaven-open-air-p.label: Not a normal dog visit
curated-attraction:stonehaven-open-air-p.summary: Dogs are not part of ordinary public swim sessions. Separate, bookable dog-swim events may run after the summer season; do not infer general pool access.

curated-attraction:stonehaven-harbour-au.label: Dog-suitable waterfront with working hazards
curated-attraction:stonehaven-harbour-au.summary: Dogs can share the public harbour walk on a short lead. Vehicles, boats, quay edges, food areas and crowds require close control.
curated-attraction:stonehaven-harbour-au.sourceName: Stonehaven harbour audit and Outdoor Access Code

curated-attraction:stonehaven-beach-prom.label: Strong dog-walking seafront
curated-attraction:stonehaven-beach-prom.summary: The beach and promenade give a substantial outdoor dog visit. Keep close control around wildlife, children, food, roads and rough water, and obey any current signs.
curated-attraction:stonehaven-beach-prom.sourceName: Stonehaven beach audit and Outdoor Access Code

curated-attraction:stonehaven-tolbooth-m.label: Museum dog policy not published
curated-attraction:stonehaven-tolbooth-m.summary: No reliable current dog policy is published for the small museum interior. Confirm directly rather than assuming pet-dog access.

curated-trails:stonehaven-parks-harbour-.label: Explicitly dog-friendly clue trail
curated-trails:stonehaven-parks-harbour-.summary: Treasure Trails marks the route dog-friendly. Use a lead beside roads and harbour edges and close control in parks and busy public spaces.

curated-attraction:dunnottar-castle.label: Dogs welcome on a short lead
curated-attraction:dunnottar-castle.summary: The operator explicitly welcomes dogs on short leads. The steep steps, uneven ruins, sheer drops, crowds and requirement to carry waste back to the car-park bins make close control essential.

curated-trails:stonehaven-market-square-.label: Dog-suitable town loop with road and harbour care
curated-trails:stonehaven-market-square-.summary: Dogs can accompany the public street and harbour route, but use a short lead beside roads, crowds, food stops, quay edges and the working harbour.
curated-trails:stonehaven-market-square-.sourceName: Scottish Outdoor Access Code dog-owner guidance

curated-attraction:stonehaven-fireballs-.label: Leave dogs away from fireballs and fireworks
curated-attraction:stonehaven-fireballs-.summary: Dense crowds, swinging flames, midnight noise and fireworks make this unsuitable for ordinary pet dogs.

curated-attraction:stonehaven-black-hill.label: Dog-suitable climb with cliff care
curated-attraction:stonehaven-black-hill.summary: Dogs can accompany the public hill path on a lead, but the route approaches steep coastal ground, livestock and exposed edges.
curated-attraction:stonehaven-black-hill.sourceName: Scottish Outdoor Access Code and route audit

curated-attraction:stonehaven-paddleboar.label: Not an ordinary dog activity
curated-attraction:stonehaven-paddleboar.summary: The published lessons, tours, rental and sauna offer does not include dogs. No ordinary pet participation is claimed.

curated-attraction:stonehaven-quay-galle.label: Gallery dog policy not published
curated-attraction:stonehaven-quay-galle.summary: No reliable current dog policy is published for the compact gallery interior. Confirm directly before arriving with a dog.

curated-trails:stonehaven-dunnottar-cast.label: Dog-suitable with severe cliff-edge care
curated-trails:stonehaven-dunnottar-cast.summary: Dogs can use the public trail under close control, but use a short lead around livestock, steep steps, exposed cliffs and busy viewpoints.
curated-trails:stonehaven-dunnottar-cast.sourceName: Walkhighlands route and Outdoor Access Code

curated-trails:stonehaven-dunnottar-wood.label: Strong woodland dog walk
curated-trails:stonehaven-dunnottar-wood.summary: The woodland paths make a substantial dog walk; maintain close control around wildlife, other visitors, roads and muddy sections.
curated-trails:stonehaven-dunnottar-wood.sourceName: Walkhighlands route and Outdoor Access Code

curated-trails:stonehaven-boardwalk-cowi.label: Promenade dog walk with cliff restrictions
curated-trails:stonehaven-boardwalk-cowi.summary: Use a lead around the promenade, roads and Cowie, and obey any closure or access sign on the northern cliff section.
curated-trails:stonehaven-boardwalk-cowi.sourceName: East Grampian Coastal Partnership route review

curated-trails:stonehaven-mineralwell-pa.label: Good riverside park dog walk
curated-trails:stonehaven-mineralwell-pa.summary: The open park circuit is useful with a dog; keep close control around children, sport, wildlife and the river.
curated-trails:stonehaven-mineralwell-pa.sourceName: Scottish Outdoor Access Code and council route map

curated-picnic:stonehaven-beach-road-tab.label: Dog-suitable outdoor tables
curated-picnic:stonehaven-beach-road-tab.summary: Dogs can accompany an outdoor picnic under close control; keep clear of food, children and the nearby road.
curated-picnic:stonehaven-beach-road-tab.sourceName: OpenStreetMap audit and Outdoor Access Code

curated-picnic:stonehaven-bay-walk-table.label: Dog-suitable outdoor tables
curated-picnic:stonehaven-bay-walk-table.summary: Dogs can accompany an outdoor picnic under close control; keep clear of food, pedestrians, roads and harbour edges.
curated-picnic:stonehaven-bay-walk-table.sourceName: OpenStreetMap audit and Outdoor Access Code

curated-eat:stonehaven-mollys-cafe-bar.label: Dogs at outside tables only
curated-eat:stonehaven-mollys-cafe-bar.summary: Current local guidance limits ordinary dog visits to the outdoor seating area.

curated-eat:stonehaven-cool-gourmet.label: Dogs welcome inside on a lead
curated-eat:stonehaven-cool-gourmet.summary: The operator explicitly welcomes dogs inside provided they are kept on a lead.

curated-eat:stonehaven-old-pier-coffee-h.label: Dogs downstairs only
curated-eat:stonehaven-old-pier-coffee-h.summary: Dogs can use the ground-floor/downstairs area, but not the upstairs seating room.

curated-eat:stonehaven-villa-coffee-shop.label: Small dogs welcome
curated-eat:stonehaven-villa-coffee-shop.summary: The current local listing specifically welcomes small dogs; larger-dog access is not claimed.

curated-eat:stonehaven-aunty-bettys.label: Listed as dog-friendly
curated-eat:stonehaven-aunty-bettys.summary: VisitAberdeenshire currently marks the business dog-friendly.

curated-eat:stonehaven-pinky-promise-caf.label: Listed locally as dog-friendly
curated-eat:stonehaven-pinky-promise-caf.summary: The current local dog-friendly guide includes Pinky Promise Café.

curated-eat:stonehaven-cafe-noir.label: Dog policy not published
curated-eat:stonehaven-cafe-noir.summary: No reliable current dog policy was found. Confirm ordinary pet access directly.

curated-eat:stonehaven-waterfront-cafe.label: Dogs in the garden only
curated-eat:stonehaven-waterfront-cafe.summary: Current local guidance limits ordinary dog visits to the garden seating.

curated-eat:stonehaven-red-red-robin.label: Listed locally as dog-friendly
curated-eat:stonehaven-red-red-robin.summary: A current local dog-friendly guide includes Red Red Robin; confirm the preferred seating area on arrival.

curated-eat:stonehaven-graingers-delicat.label: Dog policy not published
curated-eat:stonehaven-graingers-delicat.summary: No reliable current dog policy is published by the operator. Confirm ordinary pet access directly before visiting.

curated-eat:stonehaven-drifters-cafe.label: Dogs welcomed by the business
curated-eat:stonehaven-drifters-cafe.summary: The business-managed current listing marks the café dog-friendly and describes indoor and outdoor visitor use with dogs.

curated-attraction:kirktown-fetteresso-s.label: Churchyard visit under close control
curated-attraction:kirktown-fetteresso-s.summary: Dogs can accompany a respectful outdoor visit, but should be kept on a short lead around graves, visitors, residents and the narrow access road.
curated-attraction:kirktown-fetteresso-s.sourceName: Kirktown access audit and Outdoor Access Code

curated-attraction:catterline-harbour-ea.label: Dog-suitable with cliff and harbour care
curated-attraction:catterline-harbour-ea.summary: Dogs can accompany the outdoor village visit under close control. Use a lead beside cliff edges, livestock, the working harbour, roads and residential frontages.
curated-attraction:catterline-harbour-ea.sourceName: Scottish Outdoor Access Code dog-owner guidance

curated-trails:catterline-coastal-villag.label: Coastal route needs a lead
curated-trails:catterline-coastal-villag.summary: The coastal setting is dog-suitable, but exposed cliffs, livestock, wildlife, narrow paths and harbour activity call for a lead and conservative route choices.
curated-trails:catterline-coastal-villag.sourceName: Scottish Outdoor Access Code dog-owner guidance

curated-eat:catterline-creel-inn.label: Well-behaved dogs welcome in the lounge
curated-eat:catterline-creel-inn.summary: The Creel Inn’s current operator site explicitly welcomes well-behaved dogs in the lounge area. This does not imply access to every dining area.

curated-attraction:crawton-fowlsheugh.label: Dogs on leads at all times
curated-attraction:crawton-fowlsheugh.summary: RSPB explicitly welcomes responsible access but requires dogs to remain on a lead throughout to protect the breeding colony and manage cliff risk.

curated-trails:crawton-fowlsheugh-cliff-.label: Lead-only coastal wildlife trail
curated-trails:crawton-fowlsheugh-cliff-.summary: Dogs may use the trail on a lead at all times. Steps, uneven ground, a narrow gate, breeding birds and exposed cliff edges require sustained close control.
